definitions.gloss: winning a prize, receiving an award
definitions.explanation: The act of being awarded a prize, medal, or other recognition. Commonly used in news about literary awards, Nobel prizes, film festivals, and competitions.

examples.japanese: ノーベル⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受賞|じゅしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{受賞|じゅしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved to tears when I heard the news of winning the award.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数々|かずかず}→数々：12722_kazukazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映画賞|えいがしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受賞|じゅしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{実力派|じつりょくは}→実力派：30320_jitsuryokuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a talented actress who has won numerous film awards.

notes:
Also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({受賞|じゅしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The opposite is {授賞|じゅしょう} (giving/awarding a prize), which is a homophone — context usually makes the distinction clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受賞|じゅしょう}{者|しゃ} — prize winner, award recipient
- {受賞|じゅしょう}⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ — award-winning work
- {受賞|じゅしょう}{歴|れき} — award history
- {受賞|じゅしょう}⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧ — acceptance speech
- {受賞|じゅしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧ — to celebrate receiving an award
